sources.note: Safeway for U FAQ: the Member/Wallet card QR is viewed inside the Safeway app (Rewards then Wallet); it is Safeway's own barcode screen, not an Apple Wallet pass.
Apple Community: the Safeway loyalty card cannot be added to Apple Wallet; no official Add to Apple Wallet exists.
Re-verified August 2026: Safeway for U FAQ still describes in-app barcode only; no Add to Apple Wallet pass; nativePkpass=none confirmed unchanged.
Re-verified September 2026: Safeway for U FAQ continues to describe in-app barcode only; no Add to Apple Wallet pass; nativePkpass=none confirmed unchanged.
